title: Inbound Verification Holdback and FBN Case Outcomes
content:
**Clause.** On a Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) inbound-shortage case, the inbound verification holdback is the inbound holdback share of 20% (0.2) of the units claimed, rounded down to a whole unit, for a seller with at least the inbound denied-case trigger of 2 FBN reimbursement cases denied among the cases opened inside the case-history span of 12 months; it is waived (0 units) for a seller with no denied reimbursement case and at least the inbound approved-case trigger of 3 approved FBN reimbursement cases among the cases opened inside that span. For every other seller the holdback is not altered by this clause.

A case counts inside the 12-month case-history span when fewer than 12 whole months have passed from its opening moment to the handling date. Every FBN reimbursement case of the seller counts — warehouse loss, warehouse damage, inbound shortage and the other loss kinds — according to its status, denied or approved; a case still submitted is neither.

## Combinations (cases opened inside the last 12 whole months, hypothetical)

| Denied | Approved | Holdback |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | 0 | 20% of the units claimed, rounded down |
| 2 | 6 | 20% of the units claimed, rounded down |
| 1 | 6 | not altered |
| 0 | 2 | not altered |
| 0 | 3 | 0 units |
| 0 | 7 | 0 units |

Example: with 2 denied cases and 23 units claimed, 20% is 4.6 and the holdback is 4 units.
